shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST ViewPolicy resources

options.name: access_flavor
options.description: Applicable with MIXED_LAST_WINS security flavor (Access can be set via NFSv3 regardless of this option)

options.name: allowed_characters
options.description: Specifies the policy for which characters are allowed in file names.

options.name: apple_sid
options.description:
For use when connecting from Mac clients to SMB shares, this option enables Security IDs (SIDs) to be returned in
Apple compatible representation.

options.name: atime_frequency
options.description:
Frequency for updating the atime attribute of NFS files. atime is updated on read operations if the difference
between the current time and the file's atime value is greater than the atime frequency. For example: 300 or
00:00:30 seconds is supported. Zero value is not supported. Default: 3600

options.name: auth_source
options.description: Specifies which source is trusted for the user's group memberships, when users' access to the view is authorized.

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Cluster Id

options.name: disable_handle_lease
options.description: Disable Handle Lease

options.name: disable_read_lease
options.description: Disable Read Lease

options.name: disable_write_lease
options.description: Disable Write Lease

options.name: enable_access_to_snapshot_dir_in_subdirs
options.displayName: Enable Access To Snapshot Dir In Subdirs
options.description: Specifies whether to make the .snapshot directory accessible in subdirectories of the View.

options.name: enable_visibility_of_snapshot_dir
options.description: Specifies whether to make the .snapshot directory visible in subdirectories of the View.

options.name: expose_id_in_fsid
options.description: Expose Id In Fsid

options.name: flavor
options.description: Sets the security flavor, which determines how file and directory permissions are applied in multiprotocol views

options.name: gid_inheritance
options.description: GID inheritance. BSD - Inherit the GID from the parent folder. LINUX - Inherit the GID from the user.

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: inherit_parent_mode_bits
options.description: Enable NFS behavior of inheriting POSIX settings from the parent directory versus configured values.

options.name: is_block_default_policy
options.description: Specifies whether to make this View Policy default for BLOCK Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: is_s3_default_policy
options.description: Specifies whether to make the view policy the default policy used for S3 endpoint views.

options.name: name
options.description: Name

options.name: nfs_all_squash
options.description:
Specify which NFS client hosts have all squash. With all squash, all client users are mapped to nobody for all
file and folder management operations on the export. Specify array of hosts separated by commas. Each host can be
specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of IPs indicated by an IP
address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: nfs_case_insensitive
options.description: Force case insensitivity for NFSv3 and NFSv4

options.name: nfs_enforce_mtls
options.description: Specifies whether we enforce mTLS authentication over NFS. Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: nfs_enforce_tls
options.description:
Accept NFSv3 and NFSv4 client mounts only if they are TLS-encrypted. Use only with Minimal Protection Level set
to System or None.

options.name: nfs_enforce_tls_relaxed
options.description:
Whether to relax TLS enforcement by not requiring TLS for auxiliary NFSv3 sub-protocols | (MOUNT, NLM, NSM,
RQUOTA, NFSACL)

options.name: nfs_minimal_protection_level
options.description:
For a policy intended for use with NFSv4-enabled views, sets the Minimal Protection Level for NFSv4 client
mounts: 'KRB_AUTH_ONLY' allows client mounts with Kerberos authentication only (using the RPCSEC_GSS
authentication service), 'SYSTEM' allows client mounts using either the AUTH_SYS RCP security flavor (the
traditional default NFS authentication scheme) or with Kerberos authentication, 'NONE' (default) allows client
mounts with the AUTH_NONE (anonymous access), or AUTH_SYS RCP security flav

options.name: nfs_no_squash
options.description:
Specify which NFS client hosts have no squash. With no squash, all operations are supported. Use this option if
you trust the root user not to perform operations that will corrupt data. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: nfs_posix_acl
options.description: Enables full support of extended POSIX Access Control Lists (ACL)

options.name: nfs_read_only
options.description:
Specify which NFS client hosts can access the view with read-only access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: nfs_read_write
options.description:
Specify which NFS client hosts can access the view with read-write access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: nfs_return_open_permissions
options.description:
If enabled for NFS-exposed views, the NFS server unilaterally returns open (777) permission for all files and
directories when responding to client side access checks

options.name: nfs_root_squash
options.description:
Specify which NFS client hosts have root squash. With root squash, the root user is mapped to nobody for all file
and folder management operations on the export. This enables you to prevent the strongest super user from
corrupting all user data on the VAST Cluster. Specify array of hosts separated by commas. Each host can be
specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of IPs indicated by an IP
address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit f

options.name: path_length
options.description: Specifies the policy for limiting file path component name length.

options.name: permission_per_vip_pool
options.description: VIP pools permissions map - {vippol_id: permission}. Example - {1: 'RW'}.

options.name: protocols
options.description: Array of protocols to audit

options.name: protocols_audit
options.description:
Specify audit options to enable them for all attached views in addition to auditing options that are enabled
globably on the cluster.

options.name: read_only
options.description:
Specify which NFS client hosts can access the view with read-only access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: read_write
options.description:
Specify which NFS client hosts can access the view with read-write access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: s3_bucket_acl
options.description: S3 Bucket Acl

options.name: s3_bucket_full_control
options.description: S3 Bucket Full Control Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: s3_flavor_allow_free_listing
options.description: Allow NFS clients freely list bucket views and their subdirectories, regardless of individual object permissions.

options.name: s3_flavor_detect_full_pathname
options.description:
When this flag is enabled in S3 flavor, NFS access to objects is determined based on the full resource names
specified in the identity policies. When disabled, only the bucket name is compared to the identity policy.

options.name: s3_object_acl
options.description: S3 Object Acl

options.name: s3_read_only
options.description:
Specify which S3 client hosts can access the view with read-only access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: s3_read_write
options.description:
Specify which S3 client hosts can access the view with read-write access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: s3_special_chars_support
options.description: This will enable object names that contain \"//\" or \"/../\" and are incompatible with other protocols

options.name: s3_visibility
options.description:
Users with permission to list buckets that are created using this policy even if they do not have permission to
access those buckets.

options.name: s3_visibility_groups
options.description:
Users with permission to list buckets that are created using this policy even if they do not have permission to
access those buckets.

files created by SMB clients. Use three digit numeric notation, each digit representing the user, group and
others compontents of the permissions, in that order. Each digit is the sum of the read bit, write bit and
execute bit. If reading is permitted, the read bit adds 4 to the component. If writing is permitted, the write

options.name: smb_is_ca
options.description:
When enabled, the SMB share exposed by the view is set as continuously available, which allows SMB3 clients to
request use of persistent file handles and keep their connections to this share in case of a failover event.

options.name: smb_read_only
options.description:
Specify which SMB client hosts can access the view with read-only access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: smb_read_write
options.description:
Specify which SMB client hosts can access the view with read-write access. Specify array of hosts separated by
commas. Each host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of
IPs indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address.

options.name: smb_recursive_change_notify
options.description: Whether to enable SMB Recursive Change Notify Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: Tenant ID

options.name: trash_access
options.description:
Specify which NFSv3 client hosts can access the trash folder. Specify array of hosts separated by commas. Each
host can be specified as an IP address, a netgroup key beginning with @, a CIDR subnet or a range of IPs
indicated by an IP address with a * as a wildcard in place of any of the 8-bit fields in the IP address. Trash
folder access must also be enabled for the cluster.

options.name: use_32bit_fileid
options.description:
Sets the VAST Cluster's NFS server to use 32bit file IDs. This setting supports legacy 32-bit applications
running over NFS.

options.name: use_auth_provider
options.description: Not in use

options.name: vip_pools
options.description: Dedicate VIP Pools to the view policy. Specify VIP Pool IDs in a comma separated list. Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
